newsitem.title: GERMANY: Washington's Christopher arrives in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Washington's Christopher arrives in Germany.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher arrived in Bonn on Thursday for talks about the current crisis in Iraq and other European-related issues.

Christopher will meet German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Friday and then travel to Stuttgart, where he is set to deliver on Friday afternoon what U.S. officials are saying will be a major address on European security.
Christopher is due to leave Germany on Saturday for London.
